device_entry.name: Robo HAT MM1 电机与转向控制板
device_entry.name_en: Robo HAT MM1 Motor and Steering Controller
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
PWM信号输出与执行器驱动
device_entry.description: 用于机器人小车的PWM控制板，可将转向和油门指令转换为PWM脉冲输出，以驱动转向舵机和电机油门，并支持数值校验、限幅与安全关闭。
device_entry.description_en: A PWM control board for robotic vehicles that converts steering and throttle commands into PWM pulse outputs to drive a steering servo and motor throttle, with value validation, clamping, and safe shutdown support.

schema.description: 将超出允许范围的控制值裁剪到有效区间。
schema.description_en: Clamp a control value that is outside the allowed range into the valid interval.

schema.description: 设置转向和油门的PWM脉冲值。
schema.description_en: Set the PWM pulse values for steering and throttle.

schema.description: 检查给定的PWM值是否有效。
schema.description_en: Check whether a given PWM value is valid.

schema.description: 将转向和油门命令写入PWM输出。
schema.description_en: Write steering and throttle commands to the PWM outputs.

schema.description: 执行一次转向和油门控制更新并输出PWM信号。
schema.description_en: Perform one steering and throttle control update and output PWM signals.

schema.description: 关闭控制板输出以安全停止设备。
schema.description_en: Shut down the controller outputs to safely stop the device.
